beats_top.query: cornell off campus jobs ithaca students part time
beats_top.why: The #1 result (Cornell Student Employment) is a generic guide that does not place students in jobs and says little about off-campus Ithaca work. Ours opens with the Community Work-Study answer, gives real pay figures from local listings, and covers bus access and class-schedule limits. It is weaker on Collegetown and tutoring specifics, which are thin.
changes: Replace the Starbucks example with a current one, or frame it as a closed location and a general lesson about break scheduling.
Link the Cornell Student Employment job search so students can find the central listing.
Add the F-1 CPT eligibility condition: one academic year of full-time enrollment first.

fixes: In the 'Collegetown and the Commons' section, correct the Starbucks bullet: the Nov 4, 2026 Vink column describes the Collegetown Starbucks as a former location and cites a 2022 Sun article for the time-off claim. Say so, remove the implication that it is a current employer, and keep the 'ask about break scheduling' advice. Source https://www.cornellsun.com/article/2026/11/vink-get-starbucks-actually-off-campus

Fix the Brous sentence: say the group cut 400 jobs across Collegetown Bagels, Rulloff's, Ithaca Bakery and Agava in three weeks, and that the Sun cites the student exodus plus COVID restrictions as the cause of the broader downturn, not of these layoffs specifically. Source https://www.cornellsun.com/article/2020/04/ithaca-in-numbers-layoffs-surge-as-covid-19-and-student-departures-devastates-hospitality-sales

Remove 'the Canopy line cook listing says exactly that' (evening, weekend and holiday coverage), or confirm it on the Canopy listing at https://business.tompkinschamber.org/jobs and link that listing; the board summary did not show it.

In 'If you are on an F-1 visa', add that CPT requires one academic year (two full semesters) of full-time enrollment first, apply at least three business weeks ahead, and cannot be backdated; source https://international.globallearning.cornell.edu/employment-and-taxes/f-1-cpt
Link the Cornell Student Employment page https://www.studentemployment.cornell.edu/students in 'Which route fits you' as the central place to look, since the top search result is that page.
